name: Efficient Repairs
body:
Your caravan is particularly easy to repair.

Prerequisite: Defense 3.

Benefit: Whenever you make a special Security check to repair your caravan, you gain a +2 bonus on the roll.

Special: You can gain this feat up to three times. Its effects stack.
